title: cyperus phaeolepis var. albiflorus
intro: Cyperus phaeolepis var. albiflorus, commonly known as the White-flowered Umbrella Sedge, is a plant species in the sedge family (Cyperaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, as well as antioxidant properties that may help protect against oxidative stress and cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Cyperus phaeolepis var. albiflorus include its potential to reduce inflammation, alleviate pain, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects, making it a subject of interest for the treatment of various diseases. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
